description: (0.5.0, Draft) Retracting a list version (RFC-ACDP-0020 §5.3). Behavioral, consumer-side.

input.golden: trust-001 vector 1 (tenant-acme.production, serial 7, issuer = the sig-003 did:key)

scenarios.name: A — issuer retraction of the floor

expected.behavior: An admitted retracted event with actor = the issuer, signed by the issuer, on serial 7: serial 7 is not used and serial 6 is NOT used either; the pin is list_invalid with reason retracted.
The issuer then publishes serial 8: selected; the pin is usable.
A retracted event whose actor is the serving registry: reported, but serial 7 stays selected and usable.

scenarios.name: D — retraction of an older version

expected.behavior: Serial 6 retracted while serial 7 is current: no effect on selection.
